one_liner: Open-source CRM platform providing customizable data models, REST and GraphQL APIs, and native MCP support.
auth_notes: Supports dynamic client registration via RFC 7591 for OAuth2 (authorization code with PKCE and client credentials) as well as static API keys.
access_notes: Sign up for Cloud with a free trial or self-host for free; developer platform and APIs are accessible out-of-the-box.
api_notes: Core API and Metadata API supporting CRUD, batch operations, filtering, and schema management via REST and GraphQL.
blocker_notes: Fully accessible public API with self-serve signup and official MCP support.

auth.quote: Twenty implements OAuth 2.0 with authorization code + PKCE for user-facing apps and client credentials for server-to-server access.

access.quote: Start your free trial today without credit card.

api.quote: Core API — /rest/ and /graphql/ CRUD on records: People, Companies, Opportunities, your custom objects. Query, filter, traverse relations.

mcp.quote: Yes. Every Cloud workspace ships with a native MCP server. Connect your AI assistant via OAuth and it can read and write your CRM data in natural language.

verdict.quote: Sign up for Cloud in under a minute and start your 30-day trial.
